protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real, still-published GHSA-wrwh-rpq4-87hf / CVE-2026-40245 (CVE.org state PUBLISHED, GHSA withdrawn_at null). GET /nudr-dr/v2/application-data/influenceData/subs-to-notify is required by 3GPP TS 29.519 to take at least one of dnn/snssai/internal-Group-Id/supi. In the vulnerable gin handler HandleApplicationDataInfluenceDataSubsToNotifyGet, both the malformed-snssai branch and the all-empty-filter branch call c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, problemDetails) and do not return, then fall through to ApplicationDataInfluenceDataSubsToNotifyGetProcedure. With empty filters the procedure walks udrSelf.InfluenceDataSubscriptions and appends every TrafficInfluSub (including Supis) then writes c.JSON(http.StatusOK, response), so gin emits a 400 status with a concatenated body containing the 400 problemDetails plus the subscription list. RouterAuthorizationCheck is a no-op when UDRContext.OAuth2Required is false (zero-value / NRF oauth2 not enabled; default udrcfg.yaml uses http SBI), matching the unauthenticated SBI disclosure claim.
